scope: hypothetical economy-only reference model; not production contract proof

witnesses.name: premature harvest has no resource or purse side effect
one harvest round collects all four ready plants exactly once
a repeated harvest or main craft in the same day is rejected atomically
new plant consumes one seed and gains its first tick that day
four slots are hard bounded including tree
ready perennial has only one held output and no invisible regrowth
tree stops at ten outputs, fruit stops at six, first yield included
one craft consumes precisely 3/6/8/10 wood with no raw-wood export
seeds, saplings and food/water gifts cannot be shipped
mailbox shipment consumes goods and repeated finalization cannot duplicate reward
four-unit shipping limit rejects entire overlarge request, leaving stored stock
each phase has one ordinary routine; a second shipment is not free
one daily shipment across distinct phases matches top-four quote reservation
failed AI attempt consumes no biology, crops, goods, purse or issuance
permissionless expiry releases capacity and rejects late result
retry has a fresh attempt id but the exact same unspent production base
transfer is locked while pending; after release old owner loses all purse authority
withdrawal during AI pending cannot be overwritten by later reward credit
dead life cannot produce but purse withdrawal remains direct and available when paused
valid shipment before death is credited; death discards only unshipped production
a fabricated death flag and all post-death actions are rejected
accepted price snapshot survives later issuance or market version change
global reservation prevents many independent NFTs overbooking token capacity
NFT creation burn cannot lower lifetime pressure or reset per-life progression
advisory goal cannot create material, change purse or bypass a pending base
waiting real time alone cannot advance growth, day or purse
an exhausted issuance bucket still admits care and growth without shipping
care-only accepted request cannot consume a zero-reward shipment
last reservation won by one NPC does not prevent another NPC care day
first seed comes from Day1 kit; failed kit is not granted and retry may change kit
owner can atomically mint new NFT from a dead-life purse with conserved burn
purse NFT-mint intent nonce cannot replay and approved operators have no purse rights
ownership round trip invalidates an old unused purse mint intent
purse mint while AI pending preserves later incremental reward credit
tentative NEAR transfer-call owner cannot mint from purse or withdraw it
